IC1: Male [OR] or female >40 and <70 years old.
IC2: Has a body mass index >27 and <47 kg/m2.
IC4: [NOT] Not currently engaged in > 60 min/wk of exercise
IC5: Meet at least 3 of 5 National Cholesterol Education Adult Treatment Panel III
IC6: Increased waist circumference (=102 cm in men [OR]; =88 cm in women)
IC7: Elevated triglycerides (=150 mg/dl), or on medication for treating the condition
IC8: Reduced HDL-cholesterol (<40mg/dl in men [OR], <50 mg/dl in women), or on medication for treating the condition
IC9: High blood pressure [AND] (=130 mmHg systolic [OR] or =85mmHg diastolic), or on medication for treating the condition
IC10: Elevated fasting glucose [AND] (=100 mg/dl), or on medication for treating the condition
